status: Depth fill/readback regression fixed; original Wine DDraw remains incomplete and failing.
changes: Validate fill destination formats, supplied sources, conflicting flags and source/destination rectangles before emission; preserve source-independent ROP behavior and native depth packing.

Mirror known integer depth fills exactly into CPU memory, including D32 and immediate system-memory pointer visibility; do not validate partial or stencil GPU-dirty shadows. Failed commands leave CPU memory untouched.
Upload legacy depth CPU data and invalidate attached depth/stencil memory after successful GPU clears/draws. Color-only draws with depth/stencil writes disabled preserve valid exact integer shadows.

Read actual GPU depth for all seven standard packed depth formats. Read stencil via a whole-subresource stencil-only copy, then select requested rows and pack stencil bits into their native positions. Retire conversion objects on success and timeout.
